distribution.summary: 重庆；福建；广东；广西；贵州；海南；湖南；江西；上海；四川；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) confirms the reviewed range and adds Guizhou, Hunan and Shanghai in its province synthesis. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence. Smith et al. (2022) independently supports Chongqing, Fujian, Guangdong, Guizhou, Hainan, Hong Kong, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan and Taiwan and provides locality evidence from Guizhou, Guiyang; it adds no new region to the current synthesis.

host_note: Lin et al. (2024) directly reports Acacia auriculiformis; baseline hosts are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as polyphagous but records no hosts from Taiwan. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host in the integrated record; no host taxon is added.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus discolor (Blandford, 1898).

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xylosandrus discolor (Blandford, 1898), VSN_6521. Earlier profile text displayed a later authorship and is superseded by the stable integrated taxonomic backbone identity. Beaver & Liu (2010) follows the synonymy of Xyleborus posticestriatus with Xylosandrus discolor after syntype comparison.
